name: Camping 101: Blacksmithing
summary: You learn to craft a Sharpening Wheel for use in the wilderness. A campfire is needed before you can set up camp.

sections.title: Ready to Camp
sections.body: You can now craft a Sharpening Wheel. To try it out, head into the wilderness, where camps can be set up away from the center of town. Bring a campfire too; cooks can teach you how to make one.

faq.answer: You can craft your own Sharpening Wheel.

faq.q: Where can I try the Sharpening Wheel?
faq.answer: You can test it in the wilderness, where camps can be set up away from the center of town.

faq.q: What do I need before setting up camp?
faq.answer: You need a campfire before you start your camp.

faq.q: Who can teach me to make a campfire?
faq.answer: A cook can teach you to make a campfire.

angles.text: You can now craft a Sharpening Wheel for use in the wilderness.
You can learn to make a campfire from a cook.
